features: INDIA'S NO.1 GOOGLE TV PROJECTOR projects up to 120 inches at 800 ISO Lumens / 500 True ANSI Lumens - 25% brighter than the previous generation. NEXT-GENERATION ARCLIGHT ENGINE 2: Our new and improved ArcLight Engine 2 uses the latest generation LCD to deliver a brighter, more vibrant, and immersive picture, with a sealed optical design that helps keep dust out. With Native 1080p Full HD projection, movies, shows, and sports come alive with crisp detail, vivid clarity, and higher uniform brightness across the screen.
